pages.title: Enmities
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Mavkas$() against the $(bold)Chuhaister$() and the $(bold)Zlydeny$(). They leave peaceful animals, hukhas, bisyks and skarbnyks alone.$(li)The $(bold)Chuhaister$() grows weaker near a Mavka Tree and a Titan Tree.$(li)A tamed $(bold)Hukha$() strikes the Zlydeny, and it runs away.$(li)A $(bold)Nichnytsia$() usually leaves everyone alone until she sees you.$(li)$(bold)The Lisovyk$() strikes hostile outsiders but leaves every dweller of the Beyond Forest alone.

pages.title: Spirit allies
pages.text: Spirit Form does not help everywhere:$(br)$(li)$(#A33B3B)$(l:river/vodyanyk)The Vodianyk$(/l)$() switches it off for 10 s if you come within 5 blocks;$(li)$(#A33B3B)$(l:night/perelisnyk)The Perelisnyk$(/l)$() strikes even a spirit;$(li)$(#A33B3B)$(l:forest/titan_tree)The Titan Tree$(/l)$() does not allow Spirit Form nearby.
